name: Hopes and Fears
deliverable: Calibrated baseline expectations and surfaced emotional hazards

steps.text: Draw two columns, Hopes and Fears, and hand everyone notes in two colors.
Ask each person to write one hope and one fear about this work, silently and specifically.
Post the notes and read both columns aloud without rebutting anything yet.
Group the themes and name which fears point to a real risk the plan has not addressed.
Agree one action for the biggest fear and one signal that the hope is being met.

failure: Fears soften into vague worries and hopes into cheerleading, so the board looks balanced but names no real hazard or expectation.
intervention: Ask what would have to happen for that fear to come true this quarter, and write the answer on the card in place of the feeling.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A common workshop and agile team warm-up; no single documented originator.
